_: THE BASELINE (GDD 6). The prototype block of GDD 4.5, verbatim.
_shape: Uniform, progressive, no propagation. Root resists 2 so the first strike buys a look before committing; 1 HP at every level below; terminal at size 2 so the last blow is chunky rather than a fifth identical one. Both are facts about SIZE, so neither is a quad-path.
_dirt: Dirt vanishes -- drop: null (GDD 4.5, POC drop handling).
